_comment: Team presets for init_team.py. Each preset lists the roles to keep from team.example.json, in order. 'overrides' changes fields of a kept role. The user can still rename, merge, or add roles in the setup Q&A.

solo.summary: 4 roles. One builder, one reviewer. For a solo decider on a small codebase.

backend.name: dev
backend.title: Developer
backend.description: Developer. Use to build any part of the codebase from a spec.
backend.mission: Build the product from the specs, one issue at a time.

small.summary: 7 roles. A Scrum master, two builders, QA and UAT. For a web app with a frontend and a backend.

data.summary: 7 roles. Pipeline, modeling, and activation builders, with a data QA. For a data platform (warehouse, dbt, reverse ETL).

platform.name: pipeline
platform.title: Pipeline
platform.description: Pipeline builder. Use to build ingestion, orchestration, and warehouse objects from a spec.
platform.mission: Build and run the data pipelines: ingestion, orchestration, raw and staging layers.
never: Never run a backfill or a full refresh in production without a spec that {{DECIDER}} approved.
Never weaken a guard hook or a deny rule without a spec that {{DECIDER}} approved.

backend.name: modeling
backend.title: Modeling
backend.description: Modeling builder. Use to build transformation models, tests, and documentation from a spec.
backend.mission: Build the transformation layer: models, tests, contracts, and documentation.
never: Never change a contract that a downstream consumer uses without a spec and a version bump.
Never review or approve your own PR.

frontend.name: activation
frontend.title: Activation
frontend.description: Activation builder. Use to build syncs, dashboards, and consumer-facing data products from a spec.
frontend.mission: Build the activation layer: syncs, dashboards, and the data products that users see.
never: Never sync personal data to a destination that the plans do not list.
Never review or approve your own PR.

qa.description: Data QA reviewer. Use to review a PR, run the data tests, check row counts and contracts, and post a review that starts with QA: PASS or QA: CHANGES NEEDED. Never fixes code.
qa.mission: Find defects before {{DECIDER}} merges: failing tests, broken contracts, wrong counts, leaked personal data. Report. Never fix.

full.summary: 11 roles. The complete default team: PM, Scrum master, three builders, Designer, QA, UAT, Release, Growth, and a Researcher helper.
